Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1075133 (Rhodopsin kinase GRK7). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075133'. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
